mapper.sql: a.album_id, a.name, a.description, a.sort_order, a.status, a.create_time, case when a.password_hash is null then 0 else 1 end as locked, a.cover_photo_id, (select p.thumb_key from `gallery_photo` p where p.photo_id = a.cover_photo_id and p.status = 0) as cover_key, (select count(*) from `gallery_photo` p where p.album_id = a.album_id and p.status = 0) as photo_count
mapper.select:
select
from `gallery_album` a
and a.status = #{status} and a.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by a.sort_order asc, a.album_id asc
